units.source_text: 反复思量过去未来一切事情，但觉可悲之事不胜枚举。

en.t: As he thought again and again over everything past and future, he felt that sorrowful matters were too many to count.

units.source_text: 这京都地方已可厌弃，然而想起了今将离去，难于抛舍之事，实在甚多。

en.t: He had already grown weary of this capital, yet when he thought that he was now about to leave it, there were truly many things hard to cast aside.
Among them, above all, was Lady Murasaki.

units.source_text: 她那朝朝暮暮惜别伤离、愁眉不展的样子，越来越厉害，

en.t: Morning and evening she grieved over their parting, her brows clouded with sorrow, and this only grew more intense.

units.source_text: 这比任何事情更使他痛心。

en.t: This pained him more than anything else.

units.source_text: 以前每逢分别，即使明知必可重逢，即使暂时离居一二日，

en.t: In the past, whenever they parted, even though they knew they would surely meet again, even if they were separated only for a day or two,

units.source_text: 他也总是心挂两头，紫姬也不胜寂寞。

en.t: his heart was always pulled both ways, and Lady Murasaki too could hardly bear the loneliness.

units.source_text: 何况此度分携，期限无定。

en.t: How much more so now, when this parting had no fixed term.

units.source_text: 正如古歌所云：“离情别绪无穷尽，日夜翘盼再见时。”

en.t: It was just as the old poem says: the sorrow of parting has no end, and day and night one longs for the time of meeting again.

units.source_text: 如今一旦别去，则因世事无常，或许即成永诀，亦未可知。

en.t: If he were to leave now, then because the world is so uncertain, it might perhaps become a final farewell; there was no way to know.
Thinking this, he felt as though his very heart and bowels were torn apart.

units.source_text: 因此有时考虑：“索性悄悄地带她同行，便又如何？”

en.t: So at times he wondered, What if I simply took her with me in secret?

units.source_text: 然而在那荒凉的海边，除了惊风骇浪之外无人来访，

en.t: Yet on that desolate shore, no one would come to visit except the frightening wind and raging waves.

units.source_text: 带着这纤纤弱质同行，实在很不相宜，反而会使我处处为难。

en.t: To take such a delicate and fragile woman along would truly be unsuitable, and instead would make everything difficult for me.
Thinking this, he gave up the idea.

units.source_text: 紫姬却说：“即使是赴黄泉，我也要跟你同行。”

en.t: Lady Murasaki, however, said, Even if you were going to the underworld, I would go with you.

units.source_text: 她怨恨源氏公子的犹豫不决。

en.t: She resented Prince Genji for his hesitation and inability to decide.
